chapter.verse: Tua ahih manin kong it kong phawk, keima' nuamna thu leh ka kumpi-lukhu ahi ka sanggamte aw, tu-a bangin Topa' sungah kiptak na om un, kong itte aw.
Topa' sungah kilungtuak dingin Euodia ka thum a, Syntyche ka thum hi.

Himah hi, vaikuanpih taktak ahi note zong kong thumin ah: Lungdamna Thu tangkokhiatna ah kei tawh ahi zongin, Clement leh nuntakna laibu sunga min kihel ka naseppih dangte tawh ahi zongin, ma hong pangkhawm hih numeite na huh un.
Topa' sungah lungdam tawntung un; khatvei kong genkikin ah, lungdam un.
Na thudikna uh vekpi' theih hisak un. Topa hong nai ta hi.
Bangmah thu ah lunghimawh kei unla na khempeuh ah hehpih phatin na deihnate uh thungetna leh thumna tawh Pasian' kiangah pulak un.
Tua hileh khuak theihna bup a khupkhelh Pasian' nopna lemna in Khris Jesu' sungah na lungsim uh leh na ngaihsutnate uh hong hu ding hi.

A tawpna ah sanggamte aw, a maan peuhpeuh, a thupisimtaak peuhpeuh, a dik peuhpeuh, a mawhbaanglo peuhpeuh, a it-huai peuhpeuh, a pahtak-huai peuhpeuh, a hoih a pha khatpeuh a om leh, a phattaak khatpeuh a om leh, hih thute na lungngai un.
Kei' kiangpan na sin uh, na san uh, na zak uh, na muh uh thute zat-kisin un. Tua hileh nopna lemna Pasian in note hong ompih ding hi.
Tu ngawngaw-in kei nong kinna uh hong lakkik na hih manun Topa' sungah nakpi ka lungdam hi. Kei hong kinsa na hi uh a, hunpha a ngahlo na hi uh hi.
Tua ka cih ciangin kitangsapna ka neih man hilo hi. A hang pen bangbang thu ah a lungkim thei dingin ka kisin khin hi.
Nuntak kidaamzia ka thei a, a cingvalin neihna zong ka thei hi. Na khempeuh leh thu khempeuh ah gilvahna leh gilkialna, kicinna leh kitasapna, tua thusim zong ka thei hi.
Kei hong thahatsak ama' tungtawnin na khempeuh ka hihthei hi.
Himah taleh keima' gimna nong thuakpih uh pen nahoih sem na hi uh hi.
No Philippi khuamite mahmah in na theih bangun Lungdamna Thu tangkokhiat kipatcil lai, Macedonia ka nusiat lai-in piakna leh sanna ah note losiah kei tawh hong pangkhawm pawlpi dang om lo hi.
Thessalonica khua nangawn ah ka kitangsapnate khatvei bek thamlo nong puak uh hi.
Tua ka cih ciangin vanlena ka ngahnop man hilo a, nomau' neihsa a khangsak gah ka muhnop man hizaw hi.

Tu-in na khempeuh ka sang khin a, a cingvalin ka nei hi. Nong khakte uh Epaphroditus' tungpan na sang khin ka hih manin ka kicing zihziah hi. Tuate pen a namtui biakpiak van, Pasian a lungkimsak, a santaak biakpiakna ahi hi.
Tua hi a, ka Pasian in Khris Jesu' sunga minphatna tawh kipawl ama' hauhna tawh kizui-in na kitangsapte uh a vekpi-in hong dip ding hi.
I Pa ahi Pasian in a tawntung a tawntungin minpha ngah ta hen. Amen.
Khris Jesu' sunga mi siangtho khempeuh na hopihsak un. Kei' kianga om sanggamte in note hong hopih uh hi.
Mi siangtho khempeuh, a diakin Caesar' innpi sunga om teng, in note hong hopih uh hi.
Topa Jesu Khris' hehpihna in na kha uh hong ompih ta hen.
